query.text: 请帮我看着厨房的燃气灶，如果我人走了但火没关，请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the gas stove in the kitchen, and alert me promptly if I walk away but the burner is still on.

annotation.text_zh: 燃气灶还开着火，请及时关闭。
annotation.text_en: The gas stove is still on, please turn it off.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
